label: Payment Gateway
description: Which rail settled this invoice. Set by the backend on capture.

label: PayPal Capture ID
description: PayPal capture id, persisted for reconciliation/audit. Idempotency is enforced in app code (an already-Paid invoice is never re-captured), so this is intentionally NOT a DB-unique field — most invoices (unpaid / M-Pesa) leave it blank.

label: PayPal Expected USD
description: USD amount quoted to the buyer when the PayPal order was created. The capture is verified against THIS value, not against a figure recomputed later from the live invoice amount and FX rate — otherwise an FX move or an invoice edited mid-checkout fails the capture after the money has already moved.

label: Payment Exception
description: Set when a payment was captured but could NOT be applied to this invoice (amount or reference mismatch). Money has left the customer account and is owed back or owed application. Filter on this field to find payments needing manual resolution.
